blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Bangsamoro groups and their supporters will hold a rally at Mendiola in Manila on Thursday, Oct. 22, to urge President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to back a “rainbow parties coalition” led by Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) chair Ahod “Al Haj Murad” Ebrahim in forming the first regular Bangsamoro government. The rally, scheduled from 9 a.m. to 9:30 a.m., is organized by the Bangsamoro Inter-Religious Leaders for Inclusive Governance (BIRLIG), with the Save Bangsamoro Movement as co-organizer. The groups said the rally will underscore the importance of inclusive political leadership and unity as the region transitions from the interim […]...
